tools.name: get_ticket
tools.description: Retrieve one support ticket when the caller already has its ticket ID. If the ID isn't known, call search_tickets first.

tools.name: search_tickets
tools.description: Look up support tickets by customer email, status, or keyword when the exact ticket ID is unknown. Once you have an ID, switch to get_ticket for the full record.

query.description: Customer email or free-text keyword to search for.

status.description: Optional ticket status to filter by, e.g. open or closed.

tools.name: close_ticket
tools.description: Mark a support ticket as resolved and notify the customer that their issue is closed.

resolutionNote.description: Note describing how it was resolved.

tools.name: send_customer_email
tools.description: Send a free-form email to the customer associated with a ticket, outside of the ticket timeline.
